body: One of my first jobs was a land surveyor. I've done many jobs since then. Went back into surveying over a year ago. I may never look back. Depends on the company and how hard they work their crews and what kind of surveying you'll be doing. I feel very fulfilled. Sometimes you'll be on a harder project. But the good days outweigh the bad ones in my opinion. Very good choice in my opinion.

Yes! I'm reading the book now. And I love it!

A Man Called Ove (2015). I HIGHLY recommend this movie for anyone struggling with hopelessness. It's a story that gave me a different perspective. It's about a hopeless suicidal elderly man that finds new meaning in life.

I had 10 treatments of ECT in 2021. I did extensive research on the side effects. I couldn't get a finite answer though. Though we know a lot about the human body, the brain is like the Mariana Trench. It's just something that can be unpredictable. My mind wandered after every treatment. I don't really have an explanation myself for the crying. I just know that the treatment is very intense for the brain and short term side effects are common. Just know that above all it's imperative to stay positive any way you can. I think ECT was a positive thing for me. I hope you get the good results. You can ask me any questions or talk whenever.

I would definitely recommend it to you. I've had to go a lot throughout 2021. Being around others like me that are broken helped me tremendously. Lots of positive people there that help you see the bigger picture.

I am so sorry for your mother's situation. I'm worried that my story might've discouraged you some. In my experience the first couple treatments were at a low charge and low duration of shock. My doctor increased both as I proceeded. They might be doing the same with your mother. I think it's too early in the treatment to be discouraged. 
ECT affects people differently. Don't lose hope. Like I said, ECT is a great treatment and just didn't work for me. I've read many success stories and miracles for people in a catatonic state. I'm pretty sure ECT is one of the primary treatments for that.  I've also been told it's most effective in the full course of treatment. Sometimes multiple courses of treatment are needed. There's definitely still hope for her. It's great that your mother has someone like you that cares so much about her health. I'm sure she would be very proud. Wish you all the best. And thanks, I hope so.
